name: Claim Daily Activity
goal: Collect the points and rewards for the daily tasks already done, and every reward chest those points unlock — up to 3,000 EXP a day.
doneWhen: No yellow card with a blue Claim button is left, and no chest on the points bar shows a red gift badge.

steps.find: A "Rate Me" popup over the game, with Maybe Later on the left and Confirm on the right
The pod-in-a-ring icon at the right-hand end of the row of icons in the top-right corner of the game screen
steps.expect: The main menu slides in on the right: a grid of tiles, and a close X where the icon was

steps.find: The "Institute Guide" tile in the main menu: a small tile with a dark booklet icon, below Events
steps.expect: Institute Guide opens, with round tabs down a blue strip on the left

steps.find: The "Daily Activity" tab, the top round tab on the blue strip at the left
steps.expect: "Daily Activity" heading, a row of task cards, a points bar along the bottom

steps.find: A blue "Claim" button with a small red ! on a yellow task card. Not a dark "Go" button, and not a grey card marked Claimed
steps.expect: That card turns grey with a big tick and "Claimed", moves to the right-hand end of the row, and the points number on the bar goes up

steps.find: The "Daily Activity" tab again (this step only separates the card loop from the chest loop)
steps.expect: The Daily Activity page stays as it is

steps.find: A reward chest on the points bar along the bottom that carries a small red gift badge
steps.expect: An "Item Obtained" box appears showing the rewards

steps.find: The "Item Obtained" box in the middle of the screen
steps.expect: The box closes; that chest now shows a tick

steps.find: The back arrow at the top-left, beside "Institute Guide"
steps.expect: The main menu or the game screen is back

steps.find: The round close X in the top-right corner of the main menu
steps.expect: The menu closes and the game screen is back

signed: Claude, 2026-10-25 — draft, not yet run or seen on the player's phone
